summary: Jinxin Technology Holding Co filed a Form 6-K announcing its plan to change the ADS-to-ordinary-share ratio from 1:18 to 1:450, effective June 25, 2026, which functions as a 1-for-25 reverse ADS split. No shareholder action or board recommendation is required; Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as depositary will handle the exchange. The split is intended to increase the ADS trading price to meet Nasdaq listing standards, with no impact on underlying ordinary shares. Watch for the post-effective F-6 amendment and potential Nasdaq compliance confirmation post-split.
